productName: On Your Side Insurance Plan 2 / On Your Side Insurance Plan 2 – First Gift

trends.whatProductOffers: Covers 57 major illnesses, 1 minor illness, 44 early-stage critical illnesses and 13 severe child diseases, with two-tier ICU protection for conditions beyond the critical illness list.

keyFigures.label: Severe child diseases
keyFigures.condition: Covered under the child disease benefit

keyFigures.label: ICU protection
keyFigures.condition: Health issues beyond critical illnesses, including infectious diseases and injuries

exclusionsOrConditions: Definitions and waiting periods are in the policy.
Age limits for child diseases are not stated in the extract.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Given {client_detail}, the plan covers major, minor, early-stage and child conditions, plus ICU stays outside the CI list.
verificationPrompts: Ask the ages of the client's children
sourceEvidence: "Cover 58 critical illnesses (including 57 major illnesses and 1 minor illness), 44 early stage critical illnesses and 13 severe child diseases"
"2-tier protection for stays in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) resulting from health issues beyond critical illnesses"

trends.whatProductOffers: Allows multiple critical illness claims up to 10 times the protection amount, and doubles the early-stage critical illness payout.

keyFigures.label: Early-stage payout
keyFigures.condition: Under the Double Early Stage Critical Illness Payout Benefit

exclusionsOrConditions: Subject to claim grouping and policy terms.
clientProfileFit: Clients with a family cancer history

sourceEvidence: "Double Early Stage Critical Illness Payout Benefit"
trends.notesForReviewer: The extract does not spell out the claim grouping mechanics behind the 10X benefit.

trends.whatProductOffers: Offers a Continuous Cancer Income Option and a lifelong Alzheimer's/Parkinson's annuity benefit, turning cover into ongoing payouts instead of a one-off sum.

keyFigures.label: Cancer income
keyFigures.condition: Optional benefit; amount not in the extract

exclusionsOrConditions: Optional benefits may require additional premium.
Amounts and waiting periods are not in the extracted text.
clientProfileFit: Clients wanting income during cancer treatment
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Because {client_detail}, the plan can pay ongoing cancer income and a lifelong dementia annuity rather than a single lump sum.
verificationPrompts: Ask about family history of dementia
Check whether income or lump sum is preferred
trends.notesForReviewer: The extract names the benefits but gives no payout amounts or trigger definitions.

trends.whatProductOffers: A participating plan with guaranteed cash value and a non-guaranteed terminal bonus that may be declared at least once a year after the policy has been in force for five years.
exclusionsOrConditions: The terminal bonus is not guaranteed and is not cumulative.
Bonus factors include investment returns and claims experience.
Early surrender may return less than premiums paid.

trends.talkingPointTemplate: Since {client_detail}, the policy builds guaranteed cash value with a non-guaranteed terminal bonus after five years.
verificationPrompts: Ask whether policy loan access matters
sourceEvidence: "offers guaranteed cash value and non-guaranteed Terminal Bonus"
"may be declared at least once per year after the basic policy has been in force for 5 years"
trends.notesForReviewer: A top-up premium payment option is also mentioned in the source but is not modelled as a separate trend.

trends.whatProductOffers: Adds a dedicated Care Concierge for healthcare support in Mainland China and a One-Stop Oncology Service in Hong Kong, plus pre-approval medical expense and cashless service.

keyFigures.label: One-Stop Oncology Service
keyFigures.condition: Additional value-added service; not applicable in Macau

exclusionsOrConditions: Value-added services are not guaranteed and are not contractual benefits.

"One-Stop Oncology Service ... Support continuous professional care all along in your recovery journey"
